plan.cue: Quick check on PED: formula and calculation, the idea this builds on; these lettered options; wait.

data.name: PED: formula and calculation
data.note: You read a value as elastic or inelastic only once you can calculate it.

options.text: PED is the change in quantity divided by the change in price, with no percentages.
Divide the change in price by the change in quantity.
Work out the percentage changes from the new values.
Percentage change = change / original x 100

watch_for.wrong_idea: Work out the percentage changes from the new values.
PED is the change in quantity divided by the change in price, with no percentages.
